notes.title: Druidwalker is out NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Druidwalker is out on Steam NOW![/b] It is the next peaceful game produced and published by Coldwild Games!

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231060/Druidwalker/?utm_source=announcement_steam

Step into the role of a druid preparing the forest for winter. Delve into the heart of the mystical forest, explore its paths, and experience the beauty of nature. Druidwalker provides a peaceful roguelike adventure, where challenges offer opportunities for growth and reflection. Rest at the bonfire, rejuvenate, and continue your journey with renewed vigor. The game features traditional instrumental music, creating a peaceful and immersive experience. 

Watch the trailer here: youtu.be/-7Ho_vyXo80
It's a short experience, but a lot of love went into creating this one, so I hope you'll decide to give it a try! :) The game has been created by a multinational team of developers located in Latvia and published by Coldwild Games.

Hope you have a great week ahead, 
Elizabete from Coldwild Games

notes.title: The Early Access release of Stories from the Outbreak is out NOW!
notes.notes:
Attention all survivors! The Early Access release of Stories from the Outbreak is finally here!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/a5083be4e65ad4d268b45f3d08df9f6606254b04.gif[/img]

Embark on a turn-based roguelike zombie RPG with a shorter scenario that immerses players in the beginning of the zombie apocalypse. With 11 unique characters, more than 15 enemies, and three expansive maps, the gameplay is challenging, and permadeath adds to the intensity.

Form a team of survivors, traverse the area maps in search of shelter and supplies, fight zombies, and decide the fate of your crew. The game explores the apocalyptic atmosphere through pixel art and characters that speak to each other, showing polarization in views. Will different opinions prevent them from reaching their goals?

The game is available on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Join the fight for survival and make your own story in a world overrun by the undead!

Get the game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968630/Stories_from_the_Outbreak?utm_source=steamnews27march

Thank you for supporting us in our journey. Join us in [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/coldwildgames]our discord server[/url] to share your experiences, give us feedback, and connect with others survivors.

Best regards,
Elizabete and the rest of the Coldwild Games team

notes.title: Announcing Lazy Galaxy 2!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Coldwild Games is happy to announce a direct sequel to Lazy Galaxy game, called, *drumroll*, Lazy Galaxy 2. Yup, you've heard it right. We've taken the name of the first game and added "2" besides it.

You can check it out here: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/[/url]

What can you expect from it? Glad you asked!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/e52bc5479658523608a8bc046a61d2d42ce250e6.gif[/img]

Lazy Galaxy 2 is an idle/clicker game with base-building and RTS elements. Lead an evil (albeit lazy) alien race to conquer the universe! Expand your base, fight vicious foes, and conquer the galaxies. Acquire combat experience and convert into candy, the most precious alien resource!

It tries to expand upon Lazy Galaxy 1 formula by adding maps/spatial conquest, paired with pre-built player campaigns and greatly enhanced basebuilding system. You don't even need to play the first game to enjoy it. 

Lazy Galaxy 2 is a game that you can run minimized while watching your favourite Netflix show. Build the base, check out the universe map and send your fleets to start the conquest. No micro-transactions are planned, the game is a single-player premium, pay-once, keep-clicking-forever title.

Wishlist the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! By request, I'm happy to release a small patch that addresses accessibility in Rebel Story.

The patch adds option in game settings -> controller to enable mouse-only controls. You'll be able to move around / shoot / use special ability / change formation by using mouse only.

Controls:
Moving mouse = moving fleet
Mouse 1 = Shoot
Mouse 2 = Special Ability
Mouse 3 = Change formation

All the items are auto-picked up in that mode. You can only use the mouse to move when this mode is turned on.

Hope this makes the game more accessible and have a spooky halloween!
Best,
Vladimir

notes.title: Lazy Galaxy: 1.0.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks to your bug reports, we were able to identify some of the issues and create a patch with hotfixes / adjustments.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830759/b28bb99b7ec1ae9a4619addbd418c1c22c6da04a.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Add one more bonus: "floating coin error" - coins slowly fly to the left
[*]Added a hidden feature to skip a wingman next patch (by pressing "X" on gamepad or "Formation Change Button"(q)).
[*]Added a hidden feature to disable gamepad in CO-OP  (press F3 in co-op menu)
[*]FIX: if you enter the "coop" menu then Esc back out, the arrow keys are disabled (entering the "single player" menu reenables them). 
[*]Adjustment: if player dies after boss kills him (and the boss dies too), no dialog is shown and boss defeat progress is set to 99%
[*]Adjustment: make it possible for player 2 to navigate pause screen
[*]Fix: Gamepad images missing on linux
[/list]

Keep the feedback coming and let me know if you find something else or want some other features!
Best,
Vladimir

notes.title: Rebel Story demo (and full game) adjustments
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Just wanted to say thanks for your feedback with the demo so far. 

We've taken some of them into account and added them to the game:

- Weapon Disappear in 15 seconds if you don't collect them
- Char Selection Screen
- Mouse cursor should appear in the main menu after ragequitting
- 'Snake' in Bonuses -> 'Gustav'
- Longer Invincibility after taking damage on easy mode
- Removed extra sounds from explosions when your ships are damages
- Reduced the health of second boss by ~25%
- Gameplay settings are closed / saved properly now
- Diagonal movement optimized: ship moves at the same speed diagonally as vertically / horizontally (was faster before)
- Fixed tutorial dialogs / texts
- Sound effect / visual particles added when energy bar recharges
- If death animations are disabled, allies won't say anything on death
- Post-boss upgrades display text all the time
- increased firing speed from second ship
- removed shinyness from the mines (no more confusing with pickups, hopefully)

Your suggestions really help, so keep em coming! Yours, Vladimir

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830759/b28bb99b7ec1ae9a4619addbd418c1c22c6da04a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Announcing Lazy Galaxy: Rebel Story + Beta Access!
notes.notes:
Coldwild Games Presents:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830759/b28bb99b7ec1ae9a4619addbd418c1c22c6da04a.jpg[/img]

Lead the robot H-34-RT and his allies on impossible mission against O'Xelg fleet! Are you strong enough to lead the rebellion? Lazy Galaxy: Rebel Story is a new game in Lazy Galaxy universe. It combines shoot-em-up and roguelite genres by having you take control of the fighter squad, each with its own abilities, and go through 8 different challenging missions.

Pick up weapons, choose bonuses, unlock new ships and allies! The controls are similar to the shoot-em-up genre, except you have a fleet of fighters: that means you can swap between two formations to better destroy or avoid enemies.

The closed beta is going to be launched in our community soon (more than 50 people already!), so if you want to get the beta access first, find our more about the game and follow its development: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/013oJVAEt1l3JM1wC]join our discord channel[/url]!
